title: NBI chief tells Paolo Duterte: File a case against my wife if you have evidence
summary: National Bureau of Investigation Director Melvin Matibag challenged Davao City 1st District Rep. Paolo Duterte to file a complaint against his wife if the lawmaker has evidence.
